EXACT HEALTH COMPUTATION LOGIC (server.js) **Location: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Operation/Polyglot/src/server.js`, lines 1054-1075** The `computeBudgetHealth()` function is the single source of truth for agent health: ```javascript const computeBudgetHealth = (agent) => { try { if (!agent.raw) return null; // CRITICAL: Returns null if no raw content const check = checkBudget({ agentId: agent.filename, content: agent.raw }); const linePct = check.actual.lines / Math.max(1, check.budget.lines); const charPct = check.actual.chars / Math.max(1, check.budget.chars); const usage = Math.max(linePct, charPct); // Usage is MAX of line/char percentages let status = 'healthy'; if (check.violations.length > 0) status = 'over'; else if (check.warnings.length > 0) status = 'warning';
